needsNewNodes.name: Exact whole-number subtraction within 100, independent of algorithm
needsNewNodes.description: Compute a nonnegative difference of whole numbers within 100 using any valid strategy, including interpreting a difference as how many more in a comparison problem, without prescribing column subtraction.
needsNewNodes.reason: cnm_p034 requires written subtraction, while cnm_p032 covers subtracting a one-digit number or a multiple of ten. Neither is a route-neutral match for this two-digit subtraction.

limitations: The numerical answer does not distinguish written subtraction from a mental method or identify which optional strategy was used.
candidate.changeReason: Since \(11+7=18\), the corrected current difference is valid and sufficient. Retain it without inferring use of column subtraction.

review.mathematicalCheck: Subtracting ten and then one gives \(18-10-1=7\). The retained equality sufficiently states the requested difference.
